text: This clinic is terrible. The counter staff are rude, and they often tell customers who arrive early in the morning to wait outside. The queuing system is also chaotic. I made a mistake coming to this clinic. Think carefully before considering this clinic and go to another one instead.

text: This clinic has a very long wait time; I've been waiting for 2.5 hours and still haven't been treated. The minimum wait time is definitely at least an hour. The service is also poor, and there's only one doctor who moves between many rooms.
Even after straightening, my teeth still don't seem to be perfectly aligned, so I'm already wearing a retainer. There weren't really any major problems with the size of my teeth.
Terrible service, terrible doctor, the worst ever.

The scheduling process is terrible and awful. Customers have an appointment, but it takes almost two hours to actually get treated. The dental work itself is also poorly done; a tooth that wasn't broken is now cracked, and I can only chew on one side. The worst and most terrible experience ever.
